snippet.title: Girl In Darkness - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4325220/Girl_In_Darkness/
torgomind.com

Game trailer for the upcoming game titled GIRL IN DARKNESS by Torgomind. For updates or more information check: https://www.torgomind.com/

"Surge forth from thy tranquil abode, and undulate turbulently in the ganglionic causeways of yonder lagoon." Traverse horrid ruins and seek opulent prizes. A game about a girl in terrible danger.

Many thanks for Eug and Phaedra for their essential contributions to the trailer audio:
https://www.instagram.com/eugnosis/
https://www.instagram.com/phaedramiller/

Music:
The Tropics from Immaculata Dissent by Eugnosis:
https://eugnosis.bandcamp.com/album/immaculata-dissent
Additional music: 
13th century Italian Dances "Trotto" and "La Manfredina e La rota della Manfredina"

Additional info:
Traverse miserable ruins and seek opulent prizes. Ascend from the grotto to confront the disgraceful entity. Acquaint yourself with charming inhabitants. Or become infected and lose all hope as you behold the branching tunnels of tainted mucus.
